indexObservation.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
indexObservation.evidenceText: The Price of Travel Hostel Index table lists Bangkok, Thailand, Born Free Hostel, at $6.48 per night. Its methodology states that the price is for one person in a shared dorm room, including taxes and fees, using the average of a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023.
indexObservation.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; article dated 2023-01-16.
indexObservation.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world Bangkok Thailand Hostel Index dorm bed price
indexObservation.reason: Exact city row and source-defined one-person shared-dorm observation found; no conversion or ratio calculated.

currentBenchmark.evidenceText: Booking.com search results for Born Free Hostel, Bangkok show a Bed in 10-Bed Mixed Dormitory Room, maximum people 1 / only for 1 guest, at CNY 25 per night; the result explicitly says 7% VAT is excluded. The same result displays a three-night price of CNY 76 and was not used as the nightly value.
